sources.author_reading_qualification: Step3b reread Park §3, PDFp5: Theorem3.1 sends its proof to Lee Theorem18.12. Park does not contain the detailed simplex-Stokes proof; the author supplies that coordinate argument locally. Historic Step1 reading_status is preserved as provenance, not proof evidence. Step3b read Proposition3.2(b) completely and inspected PDFp7 visually: its eta_U/eta_V are incorrectly typed as degree-k cohomology classes while being used as (k-1)-form lifts, and the displayed subtraction of both boundary integrals doubles the same overlap pairing since partial b_V=-partial b_U. The local authored connector proof therefore supplies exact lifts and an explicit cochain coboundary; this source is statement corroboration only for that item.

sources.reading_status: The complete cited passages and proofs were inspected. The authored cusp proof rebuilds completeness from compact full velocity-lift tails and detects the shrinking obstruction by the published fundamental group of the circle. Martelli's displayed coefficient e^{-2u} scales horizontal lengths by e^{-u}; the immediately following printed length e^{-2u} is therefore a source error, and the local proof uses the directly calculated circumference 2 pi e^{-u}.

contents.name: Proposition 2.6: cusp injectivity radius
contents.support: The parabolic-displacement argument motivates the result. The authored proof instead computes a noncontractible horizontal loop of length 2 pi e^{-u}, shows it lies in a half-length metric ball, and derives inj(p_u) <= pi e^{-u} by an explicit normal-ball contraction.
